item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00368","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C20","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 is a highly plausible drafting template. It addresses the same 1947 GATT proclamation and the same potato items, then uses the same three-part operative architecture: partially terminate the 1947 proclamation, amend a list implementing the general trade agreement, and amend a list implementing the exclusive Cuban agreement. The child closely reuses this machinery for a later negotiated adjustment to the potato concessions. C20 and C14 contain related partial-termination and consequential-list-amendment machinery, but their correspondence is less specific.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the said items 771 [first] and 771 [second] ... are withdrawn in part and the said proclamation of December 16, 1947, is terminated in part ... with the result that ... [it] shall be applied as though the said items ... read as set forth","parent_excerpt":"The said proclamation of December 16, 1947, as amended and rectified, is hereby terminated in part so that any additional quantity of potatoes ... pursuant to the second proviso of the said second item 771 ... shall ... not exceed","explanation":"Both partially terminate the same proclamation and alter the operation of item 771 specifically for potatoes."},{"child_excerpt":"PART II To the end that the trade agreement specified in the first recital ... may be carried out, the list ... shall be further amended","parent_excerpt":"PART II To the end that the said trade agreement specified in the first recital ... may be carried out, the list ... shall ... be further amended","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the parent's second-part formula and list-amendment mechanism for implementing the general trade agreement."},{"child_excerpt":"PART III To the end that the exclusive trade agreement specified in the sixth recital ... may be carried out, the list ... shall be further amended","parent_excerpt":"PART III To the end that the said exclusive trade agreement specified in the ninth recital ... may be carried out, the list ... shall ... be further amended","explanation":"Both follow the GATT amendment with a parallel third part amending the operative list for the exclusive Cuban trade agreement."}]}
